description:
The Young Achievers Awards is an initiative launched by the Government of India to recognize and honor the exceptional contributions of young individuals in various fields. 

The awards were first introduced in 2015. 

This initiative aims to motivate and inspire the youth of India to strive for excellence in their respective domains. 

The awards are presented annually to individuals aged between 15 and 35 years. 

The objective of the Young Achievers Awards is to acknowledge the achievements of young people who have made significant contributions to society. 

The awards cover multiple categories including education, sports, arts, and social service. 

The specific goal is to encourage young achievers to continue their impactful work and serve as role models for others. 

The awards also aim to foster a culture of recognition and appreciation for youth contributions in India. 

Each year, the awards ceremony is held on January 12, coinciding with National Youth Day. 

This date commemorates the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda, a prominent figure in Indian history known for his contributions to youth empowerment. 

The benefits of the Young Achievers Awards include public recognition and a platform to showcase their work. 

Winners receive a certificate of excellence and a trophy. 

In addition, they are often provided with opportunities for mentorship and networking. 

The awards also include a monetary prize which varies by category. 

For instance, winners in the education category may receive a cash prize of INR 50,000. 

Similarly, winners in the sports category may also receive a cash prize of INR 50,000. 

The awards are open to individuals who meet specific eligibility criteria. 

Applicants must be between 15 and 35 years of age at the time of application. 

They must be Indian citizens or residents of India. 

Candidates must have demonstrated significant achievements in their respective fields. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for the awards. 

However, applicants must provide evidence of their achievements through documentation. 

The application process for the Young Achievers Awards involves several steps. 

Interested candidates must first fill out an online application form available on the official website. 

The application form requires personal details including name, age, and contact information. 

Applicants must also provide details of their achievements and contributions. 

Supporting documents such as certificates, letters of recommendation, and media coverage must be uploaded. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by a panel of judges. 

The panel consists of experts from various fields who evaluate the applications based on predefined criteria. 

Shortlisted candidates may be called for an interview or presentation. 

The final winners are announced during the awards ceremony on January 12 each year. 

The timeline for the application process typically starts in September and ends in December. 

The exact dates for each year may vary and are announced on the official website. 

The implementing authority for the Young Achievers Awards is the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

The ministry is responsible for promoting youth development and empowerment in India. 

For inquiries regarding the awards, individuals can contact the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

The official contact number is +91-11-2338-1111. 

The ministry also provides an email address for queries which is info@youthaffairs.gov.in. 

The Young Achievers Awards have seen participation from various states across India. 

In 2022, over 1,500 applications were received from young achievers. 

The awards have successfully recognized individuals from diverse backgrounds and fields. 

This initiative has contributed to a growing culture of appreciation for youth contributions in India. 

The awards also align with the government's broader vision of empowering the youth. 

This vision includes various programs aimed at skill development and entrepreneurship. 

The Young Achievers Awards serve as a catalyst for promoting excellence among young people. 

The awards not only recognize individual achievements but also highlight the importance of youth in nation-building. 

The initiative encourages young people to take active roles in their communities. 

It aims to inspire them to contribute positively to society. 

The awards also provide a platform for young achievers to share their stories. 

This sharing of experiences can motivate others to pursue their passions. 

The Young Achievers Awards have been instrumental in showcasing the potential of India's youth. 

It emphasizes the importance of recognizing and nurturing talent at a young age. 

The awards also promote a sense of pride among young individuals. 

They encourage them to strive for excellence in their pursuits. 

Overall, the Young Achievers Awards is a significant initiative by the Government of India. 

It plays a vital role in fostering a culture of recognition and appreciation for youth contributions. 

The initiative aims to empower young individuals to continue making impactful contributions to society. 

The awards not only celebrate achievements but also inspire future generations. 

Through this initiative, the government seeks to build a brighter future for the youth of India. 

The Young Achievers Awards is a testament to the belief that young people are the leaders of tomorrow. 

By recognizing their efforts today, the initiative aims to create a more vibrant and dynamic society. 

The awards serve as a reminder of the potential that lies within the youth of India. 

It encourages them to dream big and work towards their goals. 

The Young Achievers Awards is a celebration of talent, hard work, and dedication. 

It highlights the importance of youth engagement in various sectors. 

The initiative is a step towards building a more inclusive and progressive society. 

The Young Achievers Awards is a commendable effort by the Government of India to uplift and empower the youth. 

It is an opportunity for young achievers to shine and inspire others. 

The awards reflect the government's commitment to youth development and empowerment. 

Through this initiative, the government aims to harness the potential of young individuals for national development.
